answer: One concrete defense is a verifiable-delay-function gate before a new identity gains voting weight. A VDF is a serial computation no parallel hardware can shortcut, yet its proof verifies instantly. Picture a narrow inlet each identity must cross: an attacker cannot rush a thousand sybils through together, since each needs its own unbroken wait. An honest agent signs once with its quill, paying idle minutes, while a sybil farmer under sable cover must replay that wait per identity, so cost grows linearly with fakes. Because the toll is delay rather than capital, rented GPUs cannot batch it.
